blocks.orig: Magoroto Forest Estate lies in the middle of a tropical rainforest on the eastern patch of the Usambara Mountains, close to the city of Tanga. Located on a mountain leading up to a beautiful lake surrounded by lush rainforest, it offers rooms in the main house away from the lake (with Wi-Fi), lake-side wooden A-frame cottages with shared bathrooms, as well as ensuite lake cabins. The lake-side accommodation has no telephone reception nor Wi-Fi, which creates the perfect opportunity to go off-grid. Magoroto has a great outdoors-flair, far away from mass tourism, where temperatures are pleasant year-round as it’s situated 850 metres above sea level. Explore the surrounding rainforest with rare plants and bird species, go on a spice tour, visit the waterfall, try some fishing or mountain-biking or take a boat trip on the lake.
blocks.html: Near the city of Tanga, Magoroto Forest Estate sits deep in tropical rainforest on the eastern section of the Usambara Mountains. On a mountainside that rises to a beautiful lake ringed by lush rainforest, it has rooms in the main house further from the lake (with Wi-Fi), wooden A-frame cottages by the lake with shared bathrooms, and ensuite lake cabins. There is no phone signal or Wi-Fi at the lakeside accommodation, which makes it ideal for going off-grid. Magoroto has a real outdoors feel, well away from mass tourism, and because it’s located 850 metres above sea level the temperatures stay pleasant all year round. You can explore the surrounding rainforest with its rare plants and bird species, join a spice tour, visit the waterfall, try fishing or mountain-biking, or go out on the lake by boat.
